extraMeanings.en: secret and often illegal, or outside mainstream culture
extraMeanings.exampleEn: During the war, an underground movement fought against the occupation.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Savaş sırasında bir yeraltı hareketi işgale karşı savaştı.

extraMeanings.en: an underground railway system in a city (British English)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We took the underground to get to the city center.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezine gitmek için metroya bindik.

extraMeanings.en: a formal promise to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They gave a written undertaking to repay the loan within a year.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Krediyi bir yıl içinde geri ödeyeceklerine dair yazılı bir taahhüt verdiler.

extraMeanings.en: the state of forming a single whole or being in agreement
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The artist created a sense of unity by using the same colors throughout the painting.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sanatçı, resmin her yerinde aynı renkleri kullanarak bir bütünlük hissi yarattı.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: Gravity is a universal force that acts on all objects.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yerçekimi, tüm cisimlere etki eden evrensel bir kuvvettir.

extraMeanings.en: to tell someone your problems in order to feel better
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She called her friend to unload about her stressful day at work.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İş yerindeki stresli gününü anlatıp içini dökmek için arkadaşını aradı.

extraMeanings.en: to remove the bullets from a gun

extraMeanings.exampleTr: Memur, tabancayı teslim etmeden önce içindeki mermileri boşalttı.

extraMeanings.tr: (gizli bir şeyin) önünü açmak, ortaya çıkarmak

extraMeanings.exampleEn: A good education can unlock many opportunities for young people.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İyi bir eğitim, gençler için birçok fırsatın önünü açabilir.

extraMeanings.en: to undo something that is wrapped or twisted around itself
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She unwound the scarf from around her neck.

extraMeanings.en: to make something more modern or add the latest information

extraMeanings.en: to improve something or replace it with a better version

extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was known as an upright and honest man in his community.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: The whole event was an utter disaster.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone feel their feelings or opinions are worthwhile
